analysis: The PR is a documentation-only change to docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md. It bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds a short paragraph at head lines 159-161 about Gemma 4 pipeline pairs. Pairs that prefill serially take several requests at once, and pairs planned with one-chunk lookahead take one at a time, with a link to an architecture anchor. I found no code, configuration, key handling, authorization, attestation, encryption, or cache-scoping change. The surrounding text on cluster approvals, locally-only serving, link encryption, and prefix-cache tenancy is unchanged. It describes the behavior covered by T-041 (per-tenant cache scope, encrypted SSD tier) and the TB-002 and TB-011 coordinator contracts. The new sentence is a concurrency/lane statement. If it is inaccurate, it affects availability expectations, not a confidentiality or integrity control. Concurrent lanes on one pair could widen the in-process cross-request timing surface accepted as SEC-035, but the doc does not change cache scoping and I verified no implementation change. Remaining integration questions are outside the supplied evidence. They are whether the referenced anchor '../architecture/inference.md#gemma-pipeline-lanes' exists and matches the real lane behavior, and whether the underlying code change in other PR files alters cache isolation or admission. No threat-model update is needed from this file alone.
